_readme: Runnable schema example — copy it to plan.geo.json, replace everything, keep the shape. The .geo stem matters: geocode then edits the file in place, so check/links/kml/render all read one file. The same file feeds scripts/route_tools.py (days[].stops) and scripts/render_plan.py (everything else). INVARIANT: days[].stops mirrors that day's anchors + modelled strolls in visit order — the maps and the walking total are computed from it. Two stops deliberately ship without lat/lon so `check` reports them and exits 2 until you run `geocode`; that is the intended first step, not a defect. All prices, hours and links are PLACEHOLDERS: never ship them unverified. tz: 境内统一北京时间 (Asia/Shanghai) — days[].tz 可覆盖但一般不设; 设了 tz 的 sun --write 才会写入. lang: top-level "zh"|"en" — always write it; absent silently defaults to zh, wrong for every en plan. Every renderer and route_tools sun read it (--lang overrides); prefs has no lang field.
_readme_prefs: prefs = what Phase 0 (Intake) learned or assumed, written down once so Phases 2-6 and any later replan read one place instead of re-asking. Enums: theme ∈ illustrated|clay|noir|glass|journal|zine|splash (default illustrated) · pictures ∈ native|key|stock (the picture-capability check: own generator | env key (dashscope/siliconflow) | built-in stock kit) · travel_style ∈ public|self-drive|group-tour|mixed · scenery ⊂ nature|city|beach|forest|lake|mountain · pace = anchors per day (2/3/4) · lodging and budget are free text · notes = every inferred value, so the assumptions block at checkpoint (a) can be written from this one object. Every renderer IGNORES prefs (it is not in theme_common.PLAN_SHAPE) — the block is for the planning agent, not for the page.
